title: Not my fault, and I cannot pay it back
story: James was paid too much after an agency mistake, and his whole check goes to rent, food and medicine.

facts.reason: we used the wrong benefit amount
facts.stated_withholding: withhold part of your monthly benefit

statements.what_happened: I did not know the amount was wrong. Nothing in my situation changed.
statements.hardship: My benefit is my only income. Rent, food and medicine use all of it.
